verdict: A quiet day: nothing here clears the bar for a working VFX/pipeline reader, mostly papers with no tool angle and routine trade news.

stories.headline: 3DCoat adds CADQuader beta to convert CAD models into polygon meshes
stories.body: 3DCoat's developer has launched CADQuader, a beta tool that converts CAD models into polygon meshes. Useful for studios dealing with hard-surface or product assets originating in CAD formats, but details here are thin: no pricing, licence terms, or workflow integration specifics given beyond it being in beta.
stories.why: Relevant only if CAD-to-poly conversion is a recurring pipeline bottleneck; otherwise low urgency.
